note: Fishing (Items refill 12, Tyler's model). No fish entities: a cast is a server roll. Click with the rod at water within reach_m; after a wait (wait_s) something may bite for window_s seconds and a second click lands it. chance = base x fishing skill x time of day x weather x bait x stock; all through fate() so luck applies. Each 'cell' (cell_m square) of water holds a hidden stock that a catch uses up and that comes back one fish per regrow_s (a game day is 3600 real seconds), so a camper cannot empty a pond. The water type of a cell (stream, pond or lake, by its position) picks the species. Raw fish is raw_sick and spoils quickly. Not built: ice holes (frozen water gives no catch yet), spear fishing, bait items beyond the list, fish drawn in the water.
say_nothing: Nothing bites. Try again, or somewhere else.
say_no_water: There is no water within reach.
say_early: You pull in the empty line.
say_empty: The fish here have gone quiet for now.
